errors.evidence: The description claims the distribution is shown based on knowledge access, but then incorrectly groups the categories. The grouping (N+K+ or N–K+) vs (N+K– or N–K–) is actually by correctness (correct vs. incorrect), not by knowledge access (with knowledge vs. without knowledge). The grouping by knowledge access would be (N+K+ and N+K-) vs (N-K+ and N-K-).
